summary: Enhance your auditing skills with our Data Analytics for Auditors Training Course. Learn to leverage data for better insights and decision-making.
lede: Data analytics for internal auditors applies structured data analysis to audit work across full transaction populations. For audit and risk professionals, including internal and IT auditors, financial auditors, and fraud investigators, the training covers SQL data extraction, data validation, statistical profiling, and methods such as Benford analysis and fuzzy matching. It also addresses automated testing, continuous monitoring, predictive risk concepts, and dashboards for communicating findings.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for audit and risk professionals who need to integrate data analytics into their assurance methodologies. It bridges the gap between traditional audit principles and modern data science applications.
modules: Predictive Analytics and AI in Auditing
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of standard audit methodologies, risk assessment principles, and basic Excel® proficiency. No prior coding or advanced statistical experience is required, as the course introduces data extraction and analysis techniques from the ground up.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
